decisions.description: Scope LintGate manual_contract work to the WORD-scale refactor surface only, not all 17 manual_contract functions.
decisions.rationale: Most of the 17 functions are either (a) already covered by test_scale_definition.py via the SENTENCE/PARAGRAPH/TEXT integration, or (b) targeted for deletion (the _build_*_registry functions). Writing all 17 witness tests would duplicate effort and protect code that is about to be removed. Module-level invariant test (PRIMITIVE_REGISTRY structural equality) is the right safety net for a structural deduplication refactor.
alternatives_considered: Write all 17 manual contracts (full LintGate path) — too much work for code about to be deleted
Skip manual contracts entirely; rely on existing 52+ tests — loses local verification on the touched functions
